name: Hachioji City Art & Cultural Hall (Icho Hall)
accessSummary: JR Hachioji Station North Exit: 15 min walk / Keio-Hachioji Station: 20 min walk
hours: 9:00-22:00 (closed every Monday (the next weekday if Monday is a holiday), Dec 29 - Jan 3, and a few other days a year). Usage fees: Main Hall, weekdays all day 153,600 yen, Sat, Sun & holidays all day 192,300 yen; Small Hall, weekdays all day 59,800 yen, Sat, Sun & holidays all day 74,900 yen (dressing room fees included; equipment fees are separate). An additional usage fee applies when admission fees are charged.
notice: Use for the purpose of selling goods is not approved.

rooms.name: Main Hall (Dai Hall)
rooms.note: 800 seats on a single slope (including 2 wheelchair seats). Stage: opening width 18.00 m (14.00 m - 18.00 m), depth 16.35 m, height 8.00 m (8.00 m - 9.50 m).

rooms.name: Small Hall (Sho Hall)
rooms.note: 282 seats (proscenium format). Stage: opening width 9.91 m, depth 7.50 m, height 6.10 m. After the renovation, flat-floor use is not available.

rooms.name: Exhibition Room 1 (Dai-1 Tenjishitsu)
rooms.note: 1F. Movable wall available; half of the room can be used. 30 chairs, 10 tables.

rooms.name: Exhibition Room 2 (Dai-2 Tenjishitsu)
rooms.note: 2F. Movable wall available; half of the room can be used. 30 chairs, 10 tables.

rooms.name: Meeting Room 4 (Dai-4 Kaigishitsu)
rooms.note: 3F. Capacity 25 people. 9 tables, screen (W147 x H196 cm).

rooms.name: Multipurpose Room (Tamokutekishitsu)
rooms.note: 1F. Capacity 50 people. Exclusive use is rented by section. Can be used for dining or parties after a recital.

ops.prevDaySetup: The usage periods are morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00, evening 18:00-22:00 and all day 9:00-22:00, and include the time from preparation to cleanup. When multiple consecutive periods are used, the time between the periods can also be used. The maximum consecutive use is 6 days for the Main Hall, Small Hall and exhibition rooms, and 3 days for the practice rooms, studio, tea rooms and meeting rooms. (Source: Reservation page)
ops.loadingHours: The floor plan shows 2 load-in entrances: the Small Hall load-in entrance (1F) and the underground load-in entrance (B1F, inside the underground parking lot). (Source: Floor plan PDF)
ops.vehicleRules: If the parking lot is used for facility reservation, contract signing, load-in and load-out during facility use, or ticket purchase, the parking fee is discounted by 1 hour. The discount is processed at the 1F reception before payment. (Source: Parking page)
ops.parking: Underground parking lot: 23 spaces (height 3.0 m, width 2.0 m, length 5 m); Parking Lot 1: 32 spaces (height 3.0 m, width 2.0 m, up to 2-ton trucks); Parking Lot 2: 36 spaces (height 2.3 m, width 1.8 m, length 6.4 m). All are open 8:30-22:30 (entry restricted after 22:00), 100 yen per 20 minutes (maximum 900 yen per day). (Source: Parking page)
ops.waitingRooms: Main Hall: 5 dressing rooms (11.3㎡, 6 people / 11.3㎡, 6 people / 38.0㎡, 10 people / 60.0㎡, 22 people / 70.0㎡, 24 people). Small Hall: 4 dressing rooms (22㎡, 5 people / 53.5㎡, 22 people / 13㎡, 5 people / 11㎡, 5 people). The hall usage fee includes the dressing room fees. (Source: Main Hall page)
